# Assimp Inside Alibre Design

- Assimp Inside Alibre Design is an add-on that opens common 3D mesh files, so you can bring meshes made in other programs into Alibre.
  - What it does
    - Imports 3DM, glTF, GLB, OBJ, FBX, Collada, PLY, and 3DS files into the session you have open.
    - Converts a mesh to a STEP file behind the scenes, so the result arrives as normal Alibre geometry.
    - Offers a Convert File to STEP tool when you want the conversion without importing straight away.
    - Lists each format your installed Assimp build supports.
    - Adds its own menu with Import, Export, and Tools groups.
  - What you need
    - Alibre Design, with the add-on assemblies that ship with your install.
    - The .NET Framework 4.8.1 runtime on 64-bit Windows.
    - Visual Studio or MSBuild if you want to build it yourself.
  - Getting started
    - Build `source/alibre-assimp.sln` in Release configuration.
    - Copy the build output into your Alibre Design add-ons directory.
    - Start Alibre Design and open the Assimp Inside Alibre Design menu.
    - Choose the format you want and pick your file.
  - Where things live
    - `source/` holds the C# add-on project and its manifest.
    - `documentation/` holds reference notes.
    - `reviews/` holds dated code reviews.
  - Good to know
    - The Export menu entries are placeholders and show a notice rather than writing a file.
    - The project points at a specific Alibre install path, so adjust it if your version differs.
  - Use it under the MIT License.
